headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox edged the Detroit Tigers in a thrilling 4-3 victory, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Justin Wrobleski has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Los Angeles Dodgers due to left forearm inflammation. Tyler Soderstrom, meanwhile, has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Athletics with a left hip impingement. Other notable injuries include Masataka Yoshida's left hamstring strain and Vladimir Guerrero Jr.'s concussion, both of which have resulted in 10-day and 7-day injured lists, respectively.

The St. Louis Cardinals made a significant trade, acquiring SS Jonathan Ornelas from the Athletics for cash. The Baltimore Orioles also made a roster move, acquiring CF Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of the Adley Rutschman trade.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy. McGreevy pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 4-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies 7-1, handing them their latest loss. Drew Gilbert led the Rockies' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Rout Rays 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a lopsided 10-2 victory. Impact players for the Orioles included Jackson Holliday, Colton Cowser, Ryan Vilade, and Chandler Simpson, while Trevor Rogers stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks in their recent matchup. Key contributors for the Braves included Matt Olson and Austin Riley, while Gabriel Moreno and Ildemaro Vargas led the Diamondbacks' offense.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Place Justin Wrobleski on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers left-handed pitcher Justin Wrobleski has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left forearm inflammation.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their infield with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
